## Glossary (Entity Knowledge Base)

### Spice Science
- [asta.md](glossary/spice-science/asta.md) — ASTA color value definition, measurement (ASTA 20.1), interpretation
- [shu.md](glossary/spice-science/shu.md) — Scoville Heat Units, capsaicinoids, pungency measurement
- [capsicum.md](glossary/spice-science/capsicum.md) — Genus Capsicum, species, paprika cultivars
- [oleoresin.md](glossary/spice-science/oleoresin.md) — Paprika extract, production, concentration, applications
- [carotenoids.md](glossary/spice-science/carotenoids.md) — Capsanthin, capsorubin, beta-carotene, stability
- [capsanthin.md](glossary/spice-science/capsanthin.md) — Primary red pigment, structure, properties
- [capsaicin.md](glossary/spice-science/capsaicin.md) — Pungency compound, measurement, factors
- [particle-size.md](glossary/spice-science/particle-size.md) — Mesh sizing, sieve analysis, grinding effects
- [moisture.md](glossary/spice-science/moisture.md) — Moisture content, LOD, shelf stability

### Quality Control
- [grade.md](glossary/quality-control/grade.md) — Premium/Superior/Standard/Special classification
- [specification.md](glossary/quality-control/specification.md) — Physical, chemical, microbiological parameters
- [acceptance-criteria.md](glossary/quality-control/acceptance-criteria.md) — NLT/NMT, pass/fail limits
- [batch-number.md](glossary/quality-control/batch-number.md) — Lot identification, traceability
- [microbiology.md](glossary/quality-control/microbiology.md) — Salmonella, E. coli, yeast/mold limits
- [heavy-metals.md](glossary/quality-control/heavy-metals.md) — Pb, Cd, As, Hg limits by market

### Processing
- [drying.md](glossary/processing/drying.md) — Sun drying, hot air, dehydration methods
- [grinding.md](glossary/processing/grinding.md) — Hammer mill, pin mill, particle reduction
- [sieving.md](glossary/processing/sieving.md) — Particle classification, mesh separation
- [sterilization.md](glossary/processing/sterilization.md) — Steam, irradiation, ethylene oxide
- [blending.md](glossary/processing/blending.md) — Color/pungency standardization, custom formulas
- [packaging.md](glossary/processing/packaging.md) — PP bags, kraft paper, vacuum, drums, FIBC

### Sourcing & Trade
- [origin-traceability.md](glossary/sourcing-trade/origin-traceability.md) — Region-to-farm traceability, 10 major origins
